meaning: Formal bankruptcy filing or court-supervised insolvency
recommended_threshold_formula: Triggered by formal bankruptcy/insolvency filing date in legal/registry data.

meaning: Business becomes insolvent without formal bankruptcy filing
recommended_threshold_formula: Triggered when business ceases operations with indicators of insolvency (e.g., sustained nonpayment + account closure) but no filing; define as >=90 days past due AND cash runway <1M AND revenue ~0 for >=2 periods.

meaning: Business forced to close by creditors, authorities, or landlord
recommended_threshold_formula: Triggered by documented forced closure event (eviction, license revocation, court order); if proxy: stop in transactions + enforcement action within 60d.
Triggered by restructuring agreement date; proxy: new repayment plan + principal/interest modification flags.
Triggered by dissolution/closure registry date without distress flags in prior 90d; proxy: transactions stop + no delinquency/tax arrears.

meaning: Business acquired by another small or private entity
recommended_threshold_formula: Triggered by acquisition/asset sale date recorded; proxy: ownership change + continuity of operations.

meaning: Observation ends without known exit outcome
recommended_threshold_formula: Triggered when observation ends (end of data feed) without exit token; censor at last known active date.
cash_balance(t) <= 0

meaning: Cash runway less than one month
recommended_threshold_formula: cash_runway_months = cash_balance(t) / max(1, avg_net_cash_burn_3m(t)); token if cash_runway_months < 1

meaning: Cash runway between one and three months
recommended_threshold_formula: cash_runway_months = cash_balance / max(1, avg_net_cash_burn_3m); token if 1 <= runway < 3

meaning: Cash runway between three and six months
recommended_threshold_formula: cash_runway_months = cash_balance / max(1, avg_net_cash_burn_3m); token if 3 <= runway < 6

meaning: Cash runway greater than six months
recommended_threshold_formula: cash_runway_months = cash_balance / max(1, avg_net_cash_burn_3m); token if runway >= 6
cash_vol = std(cash_balance over last 90d) / max(1, mean(cash_balance over last 90d)); token if cash_vol >= 0.5

meaning: Operating cash flow negative for one period
recommended_threshold_formula: CFO(t) < 0 (for current period)

meaning: Operating cash flow negative for two consecutive periods
recommended_threshold_formula: CFO(t) < 0 AND CFO(t-1) < 0

meaning: Operating cash flow negative for four consecutive periods
recommended_threshold_formula: CFO(t-k) < 0 for k=0..3

meaning: Sharp decline in operating cash flow
recommended_threshold_formula: CFO_drop = (CFO(t) - CFO(t-1)) / max(1, abs(CFO(t-1))); token if CFO_drop <= -0.5
CFO(t) > 0 AND CFO(t-1) < 0 (or 2-period moving average turns positive)
rev_yoy = (rev(t) - rev(t-12m)) / max(1, rev(t-12m)); token if -0.20 < rev_yoy <= -0.10
rev_yoy = (rev(t) - rev(t-12m)) / max(1, rev(t-12m)); token if -0.40 < rev_yoy <= -0.20
rev_yoy = (rev(t) - rev(t-12m)) / max(1, rev(t-12m)); token if rev_yoy <= -0.40
rev_vol = std(rev over last 12m) / max(1, mean(rev over last 12m)); token if rev_vol >= 0.5
token if rev(t) <= 0.2*median(rev for same month over prior 2y) AND industry_seasonal_flag=1
token if rev_yoy >= 0.10 OR (rev(t) > rev(t-1) for 3 consecutive months)

meaning: Current ratio at critical low level

current_ratio = current_assets / max(1, current_liabilities); token if 1.0 <= current_ratio < 1.5
current_ratio = current_assets / max(1, current_liabilities); token if current_ratio >= 1.5

meaning: Quick ratio at critical low level

quick_ratio = (current_assets - inventory) / max(1, current_liabilities); token if 0.8 <= quick_ratio < 1.0
